model_annotation: The bar chart shows the negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline Mistral-v0.2 and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. The chart compares six clinical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The horizontal axis lists these specialties as categories, and the vertical axis represents the negative log-probability, with a scale ranging from approximately 4.0 to 5.8, and labeled with tick marks and intervals of 0.2. Each specialty has different colored bars, including Per-specialty terms, indicating the average log-probabilities of medical terms across specialties as predicted by Mistral-v0.2 as the base model and its fine-tuned variants for each of the six specialties. The bars for Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics have approximate values of 5.0, 5.25, 5.4, 5.1, 5.35, and 5.45, respectively. The Per-specialty terms bar has an approximate value of 4.85. There is no specific sorting or emphasis on the bars. The chart provides a visual representation of the changes in token probability for clinical terms linked to a single clinical specialty between a baseline model and the same model fine-tuned on data from each different specialty.
